entries.title: Mark 13:1
segments: What manner of buildings! An expression of admiration at their beauty and massiveness.  Most of the 'stones' or blocks, which were of marble, were thirty-seven and a half feet long, eighteen feet wide and twelve feet thick.  See note on

entries.title: Mark 13:2
segments: There shall not be left here one stone. See note on

entries.title: Mark 13:6
segments: Many shall come in my name. See note on

entries.title: Mark 13:14
segments: Flee unto the mountains. See note on

entries.title: Mark 13:20
segments: Except the Lord had shortened the days. The days of the siege of Jerusalem.  See note on

entries.title: Mark 13:24
segments: The sun shall be darkened. See note on

entries.title: Mark 13:33
segments: For ye know not when the time is. See note on
